title: RNA-FM — RNA foundation-model embeddings
description: Run the RNA-FM foundation model on a single RNA sequence and return its per-nucleotide embeddings: an L×640 feature matrix (one 640-dim vector per base), plus a mean-pooled 640-dim sequence vector. These are learned features for downstream models, not a biological prediction or a structure.
citation: Chen et al., Interpretable RNA Foundation Model from Unannotated Data for Highly Accurate RNA Structure and Function Predictions. arXiv:2204.00300 (2022); Nature Methods (2024). https://github.com/ml4bio/RNA-FM

example_summary: A tiny 14-nucleotide RNA hairpin (GGCACUUCGGUGCC), bundled so you can try the pipeline without supplying a sequence.
example_details: A small hairpin (GGCACUUCGGUGCC). It exercises the sequence -> embedding path end to end. Swap in any single RNA sequence over A/C/G/U. Real inference returns RNA-FM's per-residue embeddings (an L×640 matrix) plus a mean-pooled 640-vector; the stub returns a deterministic, obviously-synthetic placeholder matrix (engine=stub) that depends only on position, not on the sequence.
notes: Real inference uses the ncRNA model RNA-FM (12-layer BERT encoder, 640-dim embeddings, ~100M params; pretrained by masked-token prediction on ~23.7M ncRNA from RNAcentral) — NOT the sibling mRNA-FM (1280-dim, codon tokenizer). Output is the per-residue embedding matrix (L×640) plus a mean-pooled 640-vector; these are LEARNED FEATURES, meaningful only relative to a downstream model trained on them — not a structure, not a biological prediction. Downstream heads (secondary structure, family classification, interaction prediction) each need a separate trained head and are out of scope for v1. source_commit pins ml4bio/RNA-FM@348951516 (2025-05-27); checkpoint_digest is the HF LFS oid (=sha256) of RNA-FM_pretrained.pth (~1.19 GB) from cuhkaih/rnafm — both verified 2026-11-08 but BUILD-UNVERIFIED (confirmed against GitHub/HF, not yet reproduced in an image). worker_image_digest and max_sequence_length stay provisional until a Runpod smoke run; keep provisional=true until then. The runner loads via fm.pretrained.rna_fm_t12(path) (theme=rna); the baked file MUST keep 'RNA-FM' in its stem or the loader tries to co-load regression weights. Runner reports engine=rnafm vs engine=stub. Code is MIT (ml4bio/RNA-FM); verify the WEIGHTS redistribution terms separately before publishing the image. The exact Nature Methods DOI must be verified before publishing (do NOT reuse RhoFold's 10.1038/s41592-024-02487-0 — same lab, different paper).
